name: BounceCards-TS-TW

frames.best_why: All five cards are spread and readable, each tilted differently in the fan.

tagline: Rounded photo cards fan out and settle into a springy row.
summary: Five square photos with thick white borders and rounded corners sit in a tilted fan over a black stage. They pop in with a bounce and drift apart when you hover over one.
appearance: Five square photo cards with thick white frames and rounded corners are fanned across a black stage, each tilted a little and overlapping its neighbours. Soft shadows lift them off the background.
behaviour: On load the cards scale up from nothing one after another with a springy overshoot. Hovering a card straightens it and pushes the others aside, and leaving restores the original fan.
demo_content: Five landscape photos: a mountain lake, a forest, a green field, a dog portrait and misty hills.
search_phrases: fanned photo cards with white borders
photos pop in with a bounce
card fan that opens on hover
use_when: A portfolio, gallery or team page wants a playful cluster of square photos.
avoid_when: Tight layouts: the hover push moves cards up to 160px sideways and needs room.
customise: The image list, container size, entrance delay and stagger, easing, hover spread and each card's transform are props. Border and rounding are fixed classes.
weight_why: Five image cards with one entrance timeline and short hover tweens.

a11y.note: The spread is mouse-only, alt text is just card-0 and so on, and the motion ignores reduced-motion.

issues: The cards occupy only the middle third of the frame, leaving wide empty margins.
polish_why: Charming fan and clean white frames; the cluster floats in a lot of empty black.
title: BounceCards
